Zot-like protein; ORF IX; Phage protein involved in morphogenesis. In the same position and same size as the gene encoding the pI protein of F+-specific phage M13 and other filamentous phages. All these proteins have a nucleotide triphosphate-binding site. pI is a inner membrane protein. The N-termini of members of this cluster share homology to the zonular occludens toxin (Zot) encoded by phage CTXphi. However, the toxin activity of Zot was mapped to the C terminus, which is divergent in the proteins in this cluster
